description: Build Keyframe as a ChatGPT app using OpenAI Apps SDK - MCP server with tools + embeddable widget

tasks.title: Create chatgpt-app directory structure
tasks.description: Initialize the Node.js project with TypeScript for the MCP server
acceptanceCriteria: Directory chatgpt-app/ exists
File chatgpt-app/package.json exists with type: module
File chatgpt-app/tsconfig.json exists with strict: true
Run `npm install` in chatgpt-app/ - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Created package.json, tsconfig.json, src/ and public/ directories

tasks.title: Install MCP SDK dependencies
tasks.description: Install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod, and openai packages
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/package.json contains @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
File chatgpt-app/package.json contains zod
File chatgpt-app/package.json contains openai
Run `npm ls @modelcontextprotocol/sdk` - shows version installed
tasks.notes: Installed @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.20.2, zod@3.25.76, openai@4.77.0

tasks.title: Create basic MCP server with health check
tasks.description: Create server.ts with HTTP server that responds to GET / and handles CORS
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/src/server.ts exists
Server responds to GET / with 200 status
Server responds to OPTIONS /mcp with CORS headers
Run `npm run build` in chatgpt-app/ - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Full MCP server with health check, CORS, and /mcp endpoint

tasks.title: Define TypeScript types for storyboard state
tasks.description: Create types.ts with Character, Frame, Style, and ProjectState interfaces
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/src/types.ts exists
File contains Character interface with: id, name, role, visualDescription
File contains Frame interface with: id, title, caption, imageUrl, status
File contains ProjectState interface with: style, characters, frames arrays
Run `npm run typecheck` in chatgpt-app/ - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Types include Character, Frame, StyleDefinition, ProjectState with index signature

tasks.title: Implement session-based state store
tasks.description: Create state.ts with in-memory state management per session
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/src/state.ts exists
Export function getState(sessionId) returns ProjectState
Export function updateState(sessionId, updates) updates state
Export function resetState(sessionId) clears session state
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Session-based Map store with getState, updateState, resetState, generateId

tasks.title: Register set_style tool with MCP server
tasks.description: Add set_style tool that accepts style description and stores it
acceptanceCriteria: Tool registered with name set_style
Input schema validates style: string (min 10 chars)
Tool stores style in session state
Tool returns structuredContent with current state
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Registered with zod validation, returns structuredContent

tasks.title: Register add_character tool with MCP server
tasks.description: Add add_character tool that creates a character and adds to cast
acceptanceCriteria: Tool registered with name add_character
Input schema validates: name, role, visualDescription (all strings)
Tool generates unique ID for character
Tool adds character to session state characters array
Tool returns structuredContent with updated state
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Uses generateId() for unique character IDs

tasks.title: Register add_frame tool with MCP server
tasks.description: Add add_frame tool that creates an empty frame placeholder
acceptanceCriteria: Tool registered with name add_frame
Input schema validates: title (string), caption (string, optional)
Tool creates frame with empty imageUrl and status 'empty'
Tool adds frame to session state frames array
Tool returns structuredContent with updated state
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Frame created with status 'empty', optional caption

tasks.title: Register generate_frame_image tool with MCP server
tasks.description: Add tool that generates image using OpenAI API and updates frame
acceptanceCriteria: Tool registered with name generate_frame_image
Input schema validates: frameId (string), sceneDescription (string)
Tool calls OpenAI images.generate API with gpt-image-1 model
Tool updates frame imageUrl with generated image
Tool updates frame status to 'complete'
Tool returns structuredContent with updated state
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Includes style and character context in prompt, handles b64_json and url responses

tasks.title: Create widget HTML shell
tasks.description: Create keyframe-widget.html with basic layout structure
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/public/keyframe-widget.html exists
HTML contains header with 'Keyframe' title
HTML contains main element for frame grid
HTML contains inline styles (no external CSS)
HTML includes script tag with type=module
tasks.notes: Complete widget with header, style section, characters section, and frames grid

tasks.title: Implement widget state reading from window.openai
tasks.description: Add JavaScript to read state from window.openai.toolOutput
acceptanceCriteria: Widget script reads window.openai?.toolOutput on load
Widget script listens for openai:set_globals event
State (style, characters, frames) extracted from toolOutput
render() function called when state changes
tasks.notes: Full state management with updateFromResponse and handleSetGlobals

tasks.title: Implement widget frame grid rendering
tasks.description: Render frames as a responsive grid with images or placeholders
acceptanceCriteria: Frame grid displays in 2-3 column layout
Empty frames show placeholder with title
Completed frames show generated image
Caption visible below each frame
Grid responds to state updates
tasks.notes: CSS Grid 2-column layout, shimmer animation for generating state

tasks.title: Implement widget character list display
tasks.description: Show cast of characters in collapsible section
acceptanceCriteria: Characters section visible in widget
Each character shows name and role
Section is collapsible (click to expand/collapse)
Visual description shows on expand
tasks.notes: Collapsible section with toggleCharacters() function

tasks.title: Implement widget style indicator
tasks.description: Show current style status with badge and description preview
acceptanceCriteria: Style section visible at top of widget
Badge shows 'No style' when style is empty
Badge shows 'Style set' when style exists
First 100 chars of style description shown when set
tasks.notes: Badge in header, expandable style section below

tasks.title: Register widget as MCP resource
tasks.description: Register keyframe-widget.html as UI resource with MCP server
acceptanceCriteria: Resource registered with uri ui://widget/keyframe.html
Resource returns HTML content with mimeType text/html+skybridge
Resource includes openai/widgetPrefersBorder: true in _meta
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Registered with server.registerResource()

tasks.title: Add outputTemplate to all tools
tasks.description: Configure tools to render widget after execution
acceptanceCriteria: All tools have _meta.openai/outputTemplate: ui://widget/keyframe.html
All tools have _meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking message
All tools have _meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked message
Run `npm run typecheck` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: All 4 tools have outputTemplate and invocation messages

tasks.title: Add npm scripts for development
tasks.description: Add dev, build, and typecheck scripts to package.json
acceptanceCriteria: npm run dev starts server with tsx watch
npm run build compiles TypeScript
npm run typecheck runs tsc --noEmit
npm run start runs compiled server
tasks.notes: All scripts configured in package.json

tasks.title: Create README with setup instructions
tasks.description: Document how to run locally and connect to ChatGPT
acceptanceCriteria: File chatgpt-app/README.md exists
README contains Prerequisites section
README contains Local Development section with npm commands
README contains ChatGPT Connection section with ngrok instructions
tasks.notes: Complete README with prerequisites, setup, and ChatGPT connection

tasks.title: Test MCP server with MCP Inspector
tasks.description: Verify server works with the MCP Inspector tool
acceptanceCriteria: Start server with npm run dev
Run npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --server-url http://localhost:8787/mcp --transport http
Inspector shows set_style tool
Inspector shows add_character tool
Inspector shows add_frame tool
Inspector shows generate_frame_image tool
tasks.notes: Requires manual testing with running server

tasks.title: Add environment variable configuration
tasks.description: Support OPENAI_API_KEY and PORT from environment
acceptanceCriteria: Server reads OPENAI_API_KEY from process.env
Server reads PORT from process.env (default 8787)
File chatgpt-app/.env.example exists with OPENAI_API_KEY=
File chatgpt-app/.gitignore includes .env
tasks.notes: .env.example and .gitignore created, server uses process.env
